# PYMNTS.com covers Jon Molot's comments on law firm equity investments


- Law firm equity


August 17, 2025


-
-
-
-


PYMNTS.com has published an article referencing Burford Chief Investment Officer[Jonathan Molot's](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/jonathan-molot/) discussion with *Financial Times* about law firm equity investments. The article also mentions how these investments may allow law firms to invest in AI and shift away from hourly billing practices.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.pymnts.com/legal/2025/litigation-finance-firm-burford-eyes-ownership-of-law-firms/)
